requirements.text: The library management system shall ensure a maximum borrowing limit of 5 books per member to prevent abuse.
The system shall automatically notify members of overdue books within 24 hours of the due date via digital means to reduce paper waste.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The system shall log all borrowing transactions and user actions for auditability and accountability.
The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The system shall achieve a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of book search queries.
The system shall ensure 99.5% uptime to maintain consistent availability for users.
The system shall enable librarians to add or remove books with a latency of less than 3 seconds per operation.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The library management system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions.
